OBSERVED_SOURCE_FACT: The retained original EIA storage release records a 67 Bcf weekly injection, versus the 90 Bcf five-year same-week injection average. Stocks were 3567 Bcf, 45 Bcf above the five-year stock average and 143 Bcf below the prior-year level.
Official reference/underlying proxy; fixing time, market basis, dealer spread and carry differ from CFD economics.

CC_ANALYSIS: Capital Chronicle conditional analysis: The original EIA injection of 67 Bcf versus a 90 Bcf same-week seasonal average tightens the weekly refill by 23 Bcf; stocks still sit 45 Bcf above the five-year level. Weather, supply/import variation and shoulder-season demand may explain the small injection; a seasonal comparison is not market consensus or a measured surprise.
Official reference/underlying proxy; fixing time, market basis, dealer spread and carry differ from CFD economics.

CONDITIONAL_SCENARIO: XNGUSD conditional short outlook: Over five sessions, identify the next actual release/quote reaction and distinguish a surprise from carry or position adjustment. The original EIA injection of 67 Bcf versus a 90 Bcf same-week seasonal average tightens the weekly refill by 23 Bcf; stocks still sit 45 Bcf above the five-year level. Confirmation required: Next storage releases, weather-normalized demand, production/LNG exports, current gas curve and pre-release consensus; no admitted exact gas price history. No target or probability is estimated.
Official reference/underlying proxy; fixing time, market basis, dealer spread and carry differ from CFD economics.

CONDITIONAL_SCENARIO: XNGUSD conditional swing outlook: Over 21 sessions, require repeat releases and relative price/curve confirmation before retaining the proposed transmission. The original EIA injection of 67 Bcf versus a 90 Bcf same-week seasonal average tightens the weekly refill by 23 Bcf; stocks still sit 45 Bcf above the five-year level. Confirmation required: Next storage releases, weather-normalized demand, production/LNG exports, current gas curve and pre-release consensus; no admitted exact gas price history. No target or probability is estimated.
Official reference/underlying proxy; fixing time, market basis, dealer spread and carry differ from CFD economics.

CONDITIONAL_SCENARIO: XNGUSD conditional long outlook: Over 63 sessions, compare cumulative cash-flow, supply/demand or policy changes with valuation and annualized vehicle costs; an old price pattern is insufficient. The original EIA injection of 67 Bcf versus a 90 Bcf same-week seasonal average tightens the weekly refill by 23 Bcf; stocks still sit 45 Bcf above the five-year level. Confirmation required: Next storage releases, weather-normalized demand, production/LNG exports, current gas curve and pre-release consensus; no admitted exact gas price history. No target or probability is estimated.
Official reference/underlying proxy; fixing time, market basis, dealer spread and carry differ from CFD economics.
